content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm seeking advice on how to choose the correct [product_name] Power module and would like to understand why some [product_name] Power options offer 5V DC, even though there isn't any matching 5V base module. Any recommendations are appreciated. Best regards [user_name]

Hi, [product_name] Power is a series of different power supply units. The choice depends on the type of [product_name] base module you are using. Supported low voltage options include 12V DC, 24V DC, and 24V AC. For information on whether only DC or AC/DC is compatible, please check the [product_name] manual. Notice that modules powered by AC do not have analog inputs or high-speed counters built-in. Select the [product_name] Power unit that matches the required output voltage for your module. Hope this helps.
